intro.zh: 我毕业于武汉大学心理学本科，目前在心理中心参与情绪调节与自我验证研究。我的工作涉及行为实验设计、心理测量与数据分析，也包括个人软件和游戏原型的设计与 AI 辅助开发
intro.en: I graduated with a bachelor's degree in psychology from Wuhan University and currently contribute to emotion regulation and self-verification research at its Mental Health and Education Center. My work spans behavioral experiments, psychological measurement and data analysis, alongside the design and AI-assisted development of personal software and game prototypes

interests.zh: 关注情绪调节、自我概念与心理测量，以及游戏中的玩家动机、情绪体验和自我调节。希望结合行为实验、测量与软件原型，研究互动反馈和奖励机制如何影响行为选择
interests.en: My interests include emotion regulation, self-concept and psychological measurement, as well as player motivation, emotional experience and self-regulation in games. I aim to combine behavioral experiments, measurement and software prototypes to study how interactive feedback and rewards shape behavioral choices

organization.zh: PROM 开发 · 省级大学生创新项目
organization.en: PROM development · Provincial undergraduate innovation project

zh: 负责概念框架、访谈提纲、项目申报书编写及数据分析；参与认知访谈、资料整理与条目修订，将患者体验转化为测量维度和条目
结合 PROs 标准与海外量表维度，设计半结构化访谈和焦点小组调研；使用 NVivo 三级编码梳理体验主题，支持本土化条目池构建
项目团队累计访谈 283 名患者、100 位家属，征询 17 位跨学科专家意见，形成初步量表；2025 年省级大创结项
en: Developed the conceptual framework, interview guide and project proposal; conducted data analysis and contributed to cognitive interviews and item revision, translating patient experiences into measurable dimensions and items

Used PRO standards and dimensions from overseas measures to design semi-structured interviews and focus groups; applied three-level coding in NVivo to identify experience themes and inform a localized item pool

The project team cumulatively interviewed 283 patients and 100 family members and consulted 17 interdisciplinary experts, producing a preliminary measure. Provincial-level undergraduate innovation project completed in 2025
